mapper.select: SELECT process_id, order_id, seq_no, node_name, principal, duration_hours, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, status FROM t_production_process WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY seq_no ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE t_production_process SET deleted_flag = 1 WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
